Overview
A short trip, a memorable story.

A fictional exploration story: you find a letter without a sender. Five fragments lead to the University of Economics, the University of Đà Nẵng: an address, a starting year and intervals waiting to be joined.

What you will experience
1
The number that opens the gate

The first page has an empty address field. The memory keeper asks you to confirm the number on Ngũ Hành Sơn Street before opening the next page. This fictional clue refers to a real address; no letter is hidden at the university gate.

Public area near the university entrance
2
Half a century

The inside page says “fifty years”, but ink covers its starting point. The keeper recalls the starting year mentioned by the university: 1975. Choose that fragment to anchor the story’s timeline, rather than guessing the age of a building.

Public area near the university entrance
3
Fragments of time

Four paper fragments fall out of the envelope in the wrong order. The keeper asks for no new historical research: this is a logic puzzle using years as clues. Arrange them from earliest to latest without assuming every year marks a ceremony.

Public area near the university entrance
4
Joining the ends of memory

The ordered fragments reveal empty intervals on their reverse sides. Use 1975 as the starting point and calculate the distance to each year. These numbers are keys to the letter’s matching puzzle, not claims about activities at the university.

Public area near the university entrance
5
The half-century cipher

The keeper gives you a final copy mixing accurate lines with copying mistakes. The address, 1975 and the intervals were established earlier. Keep only statements agreeing fully with those pages to return a complete letter: not every line is reliable.

Public area near the university entrance

Terms of use

What you need to explore confidently, play fairly and keep your adventure on track.

The Dana Quest experience

Dana Quest is a city exploration game built around stories, observing places and solving ordered challenges. Fictional stories guide the adventure; they do not replace on-site historical information, staff instructions or real signs. Read each quest’s introduction, duration, meeting point and notes before setting out.

Play safely in public places

Stop somewhere safe before reading or answering. Do not play while driving, step into traffic for an answer, cross barriers or enter restricted areas. Follow opening hours, admission rules and venue instructions. Pause when weather, closures or crowds make the route unsuitable, and return when conditions improve. No challenge requires compromising your safety.

Accounts and saved progress

Use your own details and keep your password private. An action is saved only after the app receives a successful server response. If the connection fails, keep the screen open and retry; closing the page cannot guarantee that unsent input is saved. Pause before leaving a quest and use the same account to resume saved steps.

Challenges and recorded results

Challenges unlock in quest order. Read the question, observe the correct area and use hints when needed. The server checks results and rewards; repeating the same action does not create extra rewards. Do not alter data, fake location or exploit bugs to increase your score. If you find a problem, record the screen and the steps that caused it for a report.

Coins and reward receipts

Coins are Dana Quest reward points, not money or a bank balance, and cannot be withdrawn as cash. Read each reward’s cost and conditions before confirming; successful exchanges appear in Your wallet in Account. An in-app receipt does not automatically become an external merchant voucher. Use it outside the app only when the reward explicitly identifies its issuer, conditions and an accepted validation method.

Events, maps and sources

Event schedules, accessibility and venue activities can change. Check official sources and current conditions before travelling. Event reminders depend on notification settings, event timing, quest state and connectivity; they are not an emergency alert system. A device position on the map is an estimate, not proof of arrival.

Photos, content and conduct

Only submit content you have the right to use. Respect residents, other players and cultural spaces; do not photograph restricted areas, expose others’ personal information or send harassing content. Describe problems clearly without sensitive details. Reward illustrations and game scenes are artistic representations; read the description for the exact item provided.

Support and content changes

Find play instructions, FAQs and request forms in Account. Some screens download a report file for you to send manually; downloading does not mean the project has received it. Quest content and features may be updated, while saved steps remain tied to existing quest IDs. If records do not match, stop exchanging rewards or deleting data and contact support for a review.

Privacy

Understand which data is used, which choices are yours and where to manage them.

Data we store

When you create an account, Dana Quest stores your login name, contact details you provide, profile and selected character. Quest progress, solved steps, coins, reward history and notification choices belong to your account so you can continue on another device after signing in.

Location and device permissions

Maps and directions may request browser location access. Location places your character on the map, estimates distance and helps find destinations; GPS accuracy can affect results. You can deny or revoke permission in your browser website settings and still browse places manually. Camera features open only when you choose to use them.

Photos and content you submit

Mission photos are stored when you submit them through a photo mission; stored photos can be viewed and deleted in the photo library. Keepsake images created in the quest player may only download to your device, as explained on that screen. Profiles, support requests and reports contain what you enter; do not include passwords, identity documents or images of others without consent.

Public content and privacy choices

Your display name, character and score may appear on leaderboards when you opt in. Email and phone numbers are not public leaderboard fields. Manage leaderboard participation, promotional-photo choices and notifications in Account. Turning off a setting does not erase files you already downloaded or shared yourself.

Sessions and browser storage

Passwords are hashed on the server. A session cookie identifies the signed-in account, while browser storage remembers language and some device preferences. Sign out on shared devices and keep your account private. Clearing browser storage may remove local settings; server-confirmed account data requires signing in again to reload.

External services

OpenStreetMap tiles and external image sources or links receive network requests when your browser loads their content. These requests can include your IP address and browser technical information. Before submitting information on external source, booking or navigation pages, review that service’s policy.

Retention and deletion

The app does not currently apply a fixed automatic deletion schedule. You can edit your profile, remove photos or delete your account in settings. Account deletion requires your password and confirmation; removing account data, progress, photos and history cannot be undone within the app. Downloaded copies stay on your device until you delete them. If you have questions or find incorrect data, contact support before an irreversible action.
